result.description: High-efficiency ATX power supply for silent workstation and enthusiast builds. Delivers 1400W continuous output with 80 PLUS Titanium efficiency, fully modular cabling, and a fluid-dynamic bearing fan with zero-RPM mode at low loads. Designed for multi-GPU or high-core-count systems, it includes over-voltage, under-voltage, over-current, over-power, short-circuit, and over-temperature protection. Supports modern CPU/GPU power standards and is rated for stable operation in 40°C ambient conditions.
